$description: The roles that only pages use: the type scale, spacing, radii, border widths, layers and the widths of drawers. One tier: each token holds its value, the same in every theme, and the pages use it as a CSS custom property of the same name. The values are the ones the pages used before they had tokens. Spacing is on a 4px scale: space-2 is step 2, 8px. A half step ends in -5, as CSS allows no dot in a name: space-1-5 is step 1.5, 6px. A value the pages use fewer than 3 times, an odd spacing and a negative margin have no token yet.

font-body.$description: The font of the page: the system font, the first one the system has.

font-size-3xs.$description: 11px. The smallest text: uppercase labels and captions.

font-size-sm.$description: 12.5px. Sub titles, hints, and the labels of fields and segments.

font-size-lg.$description: 13.5px. The links of the navigation and the values of a meta row.

font-size-xl.$description: 14px. The body text of the page.

font-size-2xl.$description: 22px. A headline, and the close sign of a drawer.

font-weight-strong.$description: 600, semi-bold. Headings, table heads, badges and numbers that stand out.

line-height-body.$description: 1.5 times the font size. The body text and text areas.

letter-spacing-md.$description: 0.6px. Small uppercase labels, such as the labels of a meta row.

radius-md.$description: 4px. Small boxes, such as chips and skeletons.

radius-lg.$description: 5px. Inputs, segmented controls and the primary button.

border-width-sm.$description: 1px. The lines of panels, tables, inputs and buttons.

border-width-md.$description: 2px. An edge that stands out: the active link, a focus ring, a marked node.

border-width-lg.$description: 4px. A thick edge that marks a state.

z-raised.$description: 1. Above the rest of its box: the grid lines of the span waterfall.

z-sticky.$description: 2. A sticky head above the raised layer: the time ruler of the span waterfall.

drawer-narrow.$description: 480px. The width of a narrow drawer, such as the span drawer.

drawer-wide.$description: 620px. The width of a wide drawer, such as the evidence of a DORA row.
